page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via four bundled NVIDIA T4 GPUs based on the Turing architecture, offering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data highlights a contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.2 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core performance is strong, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 70574.45 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 287.37 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for cached small blocks at 3924.63 GB/sec, while large-block read and write bandwidths remain average at 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec respectively. Redis SET operations perform strongly at 64.27 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its single-threaded processing limitations and the absence of local storage, which requires external storage configurations. However, the high density of 96 dedicated physical cores and four discrete GPUs provides a cost-efficient profile for parallelized workloads that do not require high-frequency single-core execution. This hardware configuration is suited for multi-threaded processing tasks, GPU-accelerated machine learning inference, parallel data transcoding, and high-throughput Redis caching deployments.
